entries.cf992960a303b030: This business owns land and buildings through the company and its consolidated subsidiary Kabuki-za Service Co., Ltd., and leases them out. The theater Kabuki-za is leased to Shochiku Co., Ltd., and the theater site is partly borrowed from Shochiku Co., Ltd. and others, and partly leased to Shochiku Co., Ltd. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥2,026 million.
entries.dc20d686c300abbc: The company's policy is to provide a comfortable, safe and secure theater environment, along with food and services unique to Kabuki-za, so that Kabuki-za, the 'temple of kabuki', is a place where many people can enjoy themselves. In the real estate leasing business, the company will work to raise the value of the properties it holds, pursue higher income through use of advertising media, and build a structure for carrying out maintenance of the theater and its ancillary facilities in a planned manner. In the shop business, it will focus on marketing and inventory management, stocking products attractive to the growing number of foreign tourists.
